purpose: Exploratory paired comparison of current single-main selector and one temporal-motion ranking rule on saved MoveNet observations; not a YOLO comparison or product-accuracy claim
pose_condition: existing run-01 pose.json only; no new inference
sampling: three source frames inside each previously documented conservative solo window, distinct from the earlier 18 strict-solo holdout frames; three separate group checks
source_only_amendment: Initial 3544 and 3664 looked ambiguous for a strict sole lead when the original frames were viewed. Before opening pose outcomes for these indices, exclude both and replace with source-only reviewed 3576 and 3616 in the same P5 window. This is a subjective source-label selection and limits generalization.
labeling_rule: inspect exact source frame only; mark a strict sole lead and approximate full-body xyxy only if visually clear; otherwise mark uncertain and exclude from strict score; label before opening saved pose outcomes for these indices
comparison_rule: current saved main_bbox against strict source bbox IoU>=0.30; exploratory motion-only candidate ranks detections by median normalized keypoint-shape displacement over five analyze_skip=4 steps, with previous person matched by bbox IoU>=0.10 and at least five keypoints scored >0.30 at both times; no temporal winner smoothing or product assignment
limits: same original video and one pose model; prior windows and old labels informed sampling, one reviewer; not a fully independent test set
